clues.it: Rosa era da sola nella Stalla delle Renne.
clues.en: Rosa was alone in the Reindeer Stable.

clues.it: Anna era l'unica persona su dei nastri.
clues.en: Anna was the only person on loose ribbons.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era da sola nella Cucina dei Biscotti.
clues.en: Elena was alone in the Cookie Kitchen.

clues.it: Giada era esattamente una riga a nord di Fabio.
clues.en: Giada was exactly one row north of Fabio.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a un camino o a un regalo.
clues.en: Luca was beside a fireplace or a present.

steps.it: Solo Rosa può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 5ª è sua.
steps.en: Rosa is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 5th is theirs.

steps.en: Dario is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Luca's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 7th, column 3rd.
